TERMS OF USE (Shtick Games)

Last updated: November 2026

1. Who we are. Shtick Games is a private game launcher and collection of games. "We" means the people who run Shtick Games.

2. Who can use it. You must be at least 13 years old. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree to these terms for you.

3. Your account. You give us a name, a username and an email or phone number. Give true information and do not share your account. You are responsible for what happens under your account. We may block an account that breaks these terms.

4. Fair play. Do not cheat in ways that harm others, do not try to break, copy, reverse-engineer or overload the app or its servers, and do not misuse the Report a Problem feature.

5. The games. The games are made for fun and for religious-cultural themes. Content, levels and features can change, be added or be removed at any time, including through automatic updates. Points and items have no cash value.

6. Updates. The app downloads updates from our servers automatically. By using the app you agree to receive them. We may also show you messages and notifications inside the app.

7. Problems and feedback. If you send a problem report, you allow us to receive the technical details you send with it (see the Privacy Policy).

8. No guarantees. The app is provided "as is". We try to keep it working but we do not promise it will always be available or free of errors. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for losses caused by using the app.

9. Changes to these terms. We may update these terms. When we do, you will be notified and asked to accept the new version before you continue.

10. Contact. Use Settings > Report a problem inside the app.
privacy:
PRIVACY POLICY (Shtick Games)

Last updated: November 2026

What we collect
- Account details you enter: full name, username, and email and/or phone number.
- An ID we generate for you (looks like PG-XXXXXXXX).
- Game progress: levels finished, points, items, which level you played last.
- Technical details: app version, device type and system, and the date you were last active.
- If you send a problem report (or the app detects that it closed unexpectedly): your message and recent technical logs from the app.
- That you accepted these terms, and when.

Why we collect it
- To create your account and give you your own games, themes, messages and updates.
- To keep your progress, to see which levels are too hard or broken, and to fix bugs.
- To send you notifications inside the app.

Who sees it
- Only the people who run Shtick Games. We do not sell your information and we do not show ads. We use cloud services (hosting and a database) to run the service.

How long we keep it
- While your account exists, and as long as needed to fix problems. You can ask us to delete your account and data at any time through Settings > Report a problem.

Your choices
- You can see your details in Settings. You can turn off in-app alerts in Settings > Notifications. You can ask for correction or deletion of your data.

Children
- The app is for people 13 and older. Younger children must not create an account.

Changes
- If we change this policy you will be notified and asked to accept the new version.

This text is a plain-language summary and not legal advice.
